subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: What context carry-forward boundary should OpenClaw allow when an abort-settle/provider-error takeover rotates or replaces an active WebChat session?
rationale: The implementation choice affects session-state continuity and sensitive transcript exposure, so automation should not pick between last-N replay, metadata linking, retry-only recovery, or no automatic bridge without maintainer intent.

options.title: Bounded Same-Session Replay
options.body: Allow a narrow replay or summary only when agent, auth profile, channel/thread binding, and reset lineage match, with tests proving no cross-boundary transcript exposure.

options.title: Land Takeover Fix First
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 as the first recovery step, then revisit session-amnesia replay once message-loss and retry-window behavior is settled.

options.title: No Automatic Bridge
options.body: Keep replacement sessions blank after takeover and rely on explicit user retry or memory search, avoiding implicit transcript carry-forward at the cost of weaker continuity.

recommendation.title: Bounded Same-Session Replay
recommendation.body: Allow a narrow replay or summary only when agent, auth profile, channel/thread binding, and reset lineage match, with tests proving no cross-boundary transcript exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: The related PR review routes retry placement and session/provider recovery semantics to this owner as the closest current decision surface.
